fns.desc: wpas_ml_parse_assoc(): common_info->len (attacker-controlled, from the EHT Basic Multi-Link element's Common Info field in an Association Response) is only lower-bound checked (:4218, common_info->len < expected_common_info_len -> goto out) -- there is no upper-bound check against the actual remaining ml_len. 'ml_len -= sizeof(*ml) + common_info->len;' (size_t) can underflow to a huge value if a malicious/corrupted AP sets common_info->len larger than ml_len - sizeof(*ml), and 'pos = ((u8*)common_info) + common_info->len' (:4263) already points past the parsed wpabuf. The subsequent 'while (ml_len > 2 ...)' loop then walks pos far out of the buffer -- an attacker-controlled heap over-read driven by a wire-parsed length field with no upper-bound validation.
